notify.share: A sticker was shared with you
notify.escalated: Deadline is close: sticker is now urgent

telegram.start_unlinked: This is the Alexandria Planner bot. To use it, open Profile → Telegram → Link in the Planner.
telegram.linked: Done, {name}: Telegram is linked. Write here and the message becomes a sticker for your manager. /help shows what I can do.
telegram.link_bad: The link expired or was already used. Get a new one in your Planner profile.
telegram.link_taken: This Telegram account is linked to another Planner user. Unlink it there first.
telegram.help: What I can do • Send a message: the first line becomes the sticker title, the rest its details. It goes to your manager. • A photo or file with a caption becomes a sticker with an attachment. • Reply to my message about a sticker to comment (or answer a question). • /inbox: not triaged, /board: your board, /stats: summary. • In a work chat: /stiker text creates a sticker on your behalf.
telegram.not_linked: Link Telegram in your Planner profile first.
telegram.need_title: Write some text: the first line becomes the sticker title.
telegram.file_needs_caption: Add a caption to the file: it becomes the sticker title. Or reply with the file to my message about a sticker.
telegram.answered: Answer sent, sticker №{id} is back with the recipient
telegram.not_allowed: This action is not available now
telegram.no_recipient: Your team has no manager. Create the sticker in the Planner and pick a recipient.
telegram.prompt.ask: What to ask the author about №{id}? Reply to this message.
telegram.prompt.answer: Your answer on №{id}? Reply to this message.
telegram.prompt.snooze_date: Snooze №{id} until which date? For example 15.11
telegram.bad_date: I did not get the date. Write it like 15.11 or 15.11.2026
telegram.stats: Overview right now Inbox, not sorted: {inbox} Do now: {do} Schedule: {plan} Delegate: {delegate} Eliminate: {drop} Overdue: {late} Your stickers Being handled by others: {mine} Waiting for your answer: {asks} Waiting for your confirmation: {confirm}
telegram.menu.title: Main menu. Pick a section below.
telegram.list.head: {name} · {n} Tap a sticker to open it.
telegram.mine.head: My active stickers · {n}
telegram.write.pick_dept: Pick a team. Its manager gets the sticker.
telegram.write.no_depts: No other teams with a manager yet.
telegram.write.prompt: Sticker for {to}. Write the text: the first line becomes the title, the rest the details. You can attach a photo or a file with a caption.
telegram.write.prompt_self:
A sticker for yourself.
Write the text: the first line becomes the title, the rest the details. You can attach a photo or a file with a caption.
telegram.prompt.done: №{id} is done. Write a comment for the author or tap “No comment”.
telegram.prompt.fail: Why is №{id} not done? Reply to this message; the author will see the reason.
telegram.resolved: Sticker №{id} is closed, the author got your answer.
